title.narrative: Strengthening the capacities of Churches, Youth, Women and PWDs for Inclusive Peacebuilding in Ulang and Nasir Counties

description.narrative:
This project is designed to empower the capacities and abilities of churches, women, youth and PWDs, ensuring their voices and perspectives are more prominent in the peacebuilding process. Historically, women, youth and PWDs have been marginalized in peace negotiations, despite their significant contributions and potential to build sustainable peace in the country. Therefore, this project aims to create a more inclusive and representative peace process. The project aligns with the strategic objectives of Christian Aid by fostering social cohesion and inclusive participation of women, youth, and church leaders in community dialogue. By promoting these key groups, the project plays a pivotal role in uniting communities divided along ethnic or tribal lines. Additionally, it leverages the influence and reach of churches to bridge divides and build trust among various communities in South Sudan. The project supports the implementation of the Revitalized Agreement on the Resolution of Conflict in South Sudan (R-ARCSS) and aligns with international peacebuilding frameworks and commitments, including the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 16 (Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions) and SDG 5 (Gender Equality). Lastly, the project will leverage on the local community structures such as churches and local religious institutions with the community who are often trusted and respected by the communities. By involving them in peacebuilding efforts, the project capitalizes on their influence and networks to promote sustainable peace and reconciliation at the grassroots level.
Project location: South Sudan, Nasir County, Ulang County, Upper Nile State
